source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 玉屏峰山门
title: 十四郎喊门与青帝沉默
purpose: 承接 EP02 SC01 的玉屏山空院氛围，正式引入朝阳谷十四郎、绿眼琴老者和玄衣龙马队伍，让青帝继续以沉默形成压迫感。
image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses the prior empty-courtyard/Tianhu storyboard for location continuity. SH02 locks Shisilang. SH03 locks the green-eyed elder. SH04 locks the dragon-horse warband.
video_policy: Gemini experimental I2V should use only each generated and approved storyboard image as source of truth. No extra character or location references in video generation.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, or English words inside the image/video. The wooden gate plaque may be blank or unreadable.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue. Chinese dialogue should be added later in editing/subtitle tracks.
production_dialogue_lines: 朝阳谷十四郎奉家父之命，前来拜见青帝。
朝阳谷十四郎有家父书信及薄礼一份，需要面呈青帝。
既然青帝默许，十四郎冒昧上山了！

shots.title: 拓拔野藏身巨石后观望
shots.location: 玉屏山狭长山谷 / 松木山门外
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the input EP02 SC01 empty courtyard/Tianhu storyboard as location and mood continuity. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy short-drama storyboard frame, 16:9 widescreen. Dusk in a narrow valley between four peaks of Yuping Mountain; pine forest, bamboo shadows, jade-green mist, silent wooden mountain gate in the distance with a blank or unreadable plaque, no readable text. Adult Tuobaye age 28 to 32 hides behind a large mossy boulder with the friendly white dragon-deer crouched quietly beside him; preserve rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, relic bundle, plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless Wufeng iron object tied low. In the distance, thirty black-clad riders and dragon-horses stop before the gate and dismount, their silhouettes disciplined and ominous. Qingdi is not visible. Chinese short-drama suspense, no captions, no subtitles, no English words, no UI text, no combat, no gore, no injury.
shots.video_prompt: Animate this storyboard frame as an 8-10 second suspense observation shot. Tuobaye and the white dragon-deer stay hidden behind the mossy boulder while distant black-clad riders dismount at the silent pine gate. Mist and bamboo leaves move gently; slow camera push from Tuobaye's hidden viewpoint. Preserve all identities and the silent Qingdi-sanctuary mood. No spoken dialogue, no captions, no subtitles, no readable text, no English words.

shots.title: 十四郎三次喊门

Behind him, black-clad attendants and dragon-horses stand in a restrained formation. The gate plaque must be blank or unreadable; do not generate Chinese or English characters. shots.title: 绿眼琴老者低声进言
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the input green-eyed elder turnaround sheet as the identity and prop anchor. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy short-drama storyboard frame, 16:9 tense two-shot. A gaunt elderly adviser in black robe with deeply sunken green eyes and a plain tong-wood qin carried diagonally across his back leans slightly toward Shisilang, giving quiet counsel after the mountain remains silent. Shisilang listens with restrained anger. Two black-clad porters hold simple covered gift boxes on shoulder poles behind them. Pine-wood gate, blank or unreadable plaque, bamboo shadows, jade dusk mist, no visible Qingdi, no speech bubbles, no readable text, no English words. Mood: cold calculation, silent authority, political pressure. No combat, no gore, no injury.
shots.video_prompt: Animate this storyboard frame as an 8-10 second quiet counsel beat. The green-eyed elder leans in and murmurs silently; Shisilang restrains his anger; gift bearers stand still; mist drifts around the silent gate. No synthesized speech, no captions, no subtitles, no readable text, no English words. Chinese dialogue will be added later in editing.

shots.title: 十四郎冒昧上山
shots.location: 玉屏峰山门 / 上山石阶
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the input dragon-horse warband reference as the group and mount design anchor. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy short-drama storyboard frame, 16:9 wide page-turn hook. Shisilang, the green-eyed elder, and two black-clad gift bearers begin walking up mossy stone steps beyond the pine-wood gate toward the unseen Qingdi sanctuary. The remaining black-clad riders form a guarded ring around the dragon-horses outside the gate. Dragon-horses have horse bodies with subtle dragon features, dark tack, restrained fearful posture.
